THE SHORT ANSWER

Reddy Appraisal LLC serves Tucson and surrounding Southern Arizona communities with residential valuations informed by local market research and professional judgment.

What an online estimate can miss

Checking an online home-value estimate is easy. But what happens when the number on your screen does not seem to match your home? Automated valuation models can be useful starting points, yet they may miss details that matter in Tucson: a mountain view, a permitted casita, an unusual floor plan, a recent renovation, or a location with few truly comparable sales.

Look beyond a single algorithm

A professional residential appraisal looks beyond a single algorithm. An appraiser considers relevant local sales, property characteristics, condition, market behavior, and the quality of available data. Two homes with similar square footage can have very different values, particularly in established neighborhoods, custom-home areas, and foothills markets where properties are not interchangeable.
